features.quote: Khirbet es-Salih is marked by some modern graves.

date.basis: entry (quoting Glueck) calls the graves modern

notes: Entry says the site was NOT visited (minefields); text is quotations of Glueck 1951 and Gophna and Porath 1972. The data block nevertheless states 'Cisterns: none', recorded as C2 absence; flag: absence statement for an unvisited site. Small spring in the wadi below the site and 'Ein Saleh at the site are springs, not pools. SWP name 'Kubur ed Delameh' roughly at this place is a name only, not coded.
